title: VSOP87 planetary theory coefficients
description: Planetary position coefficients from VSOP87 (Bretagnon & Francou 1988, IMCCE). Versions A and E are stored separately.

version.description: VSOP87 version letter. A = heliocentric rectangular J2000, E = barycentric rectangular J2000.

planets.description: Map from planet name (e.g. EARTH, MARS) to coordinate blocks.

additionalProperties.description: Map from coordinate axis (X, Y, Z or L, B, R depending on version) to T-power series.
Map from T-power index ("0".."5") to list of terms.
List of VSOP87 terms for this planet/coord/T-power.
